data.standardized_narrative: The gross claims development triangle indicates a net prior-year strengthening of GBP 18.6m (2.0% of opening gross reserves of GBP 932.2m) for years prior to 2021. Development was mixed by underwriting year with adverse movements in 2017 and 2019 more than offsetting releases in 2018 and 2020. The syndicate narrative describes the prior year movement as driven mainly by favourable loss experience (net), which appears to refer to net movements after reinsurance; the gross triangle-based calculation above shows a small net strengthening.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in estimate of the prior year is driven mainly by favourable loss experience and incurred claims forms a 7% (2021: 10%) component of the 2022 loss ratio of 47% (2021: 46%).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement: there is an apparent discrepancy between Note 6 (which presents a 'Favourable movement in technical provisions' of 44.7m but appears to be presented net) and the gross claims development triangle. Per the rules, the gross claims development triangle was used to calculate prior_year_development_gbp_m (= +18.6m, strengthening). The Note 6 per-LOB movements were used for LOB-level movements but those figures may be net or gross in the note's presentation; signs were interpreted from table parentheses (positive table numbers taken as favourable = release). Mapping of 'Marine, aviation and transport'  'Marine' and 'Miscellaneous'  'Aggregate' is an interpretive mapping to standard Lloyd's LOBs.
